d: In a stunning break with her party, Democratic Congresswoman Haley Stevens has endorsed Republican Mike Rogers against Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed, just days before Election Day. The move follows an escalating feud over Israel, US aid to Israel and an outside group's campaign advertisement linking the issue to rising living costs. A planned joint appearance with El-Sayed collapsed, with Stevens instead appearing alongside Rogers in Detroit. El-Sayed dismissed the defection, while Donald Trump praised Stevens and House Speaker Mike Johnson backed her decision.
